title: The Lightning Thief
synopsis: Twelve-year-old Percy Jackson discovers he is a demigod son of Poseidon. When Zeus's Master Lightning Bolt is stolen and Percy is accused of the crime, he embarks on a cross-country quest with Annabeth Chase and Grover Underwood to retrieve the bolt, prevent a cataclysmic war among the gods, and rescue his mother from the Underworld.
short_description: A twelve-year-old demigod embarks on a quest across America to retrieve Zeus's stolen Master Bolt and save his mother.
camp_bead_description: Black bead with a green trident

title: The Sea of Monsters
synopsis: When Thalia's pine tree is poisoned and Camp Half-Blood's magical borders collapse, Percy Jackson discovers that Grover has been captured by the Cyclops Polyphemus. Accompanied by Annabeth and his newly revealed Cyclops half-brother Tyson, Percy sails into the dangerous Sea of Monsters to retrieve the Golden Fleece and heal the camp's tree.
short_description: Percy Jackson journeys into the Bermuda Triangle to retrieve the Golden Fleece and save Camp Half-Blood.

title: The Titan's Curse
synopsis: After rescuing demigod siblings Bianca and Nico di Angelo, Annabeth is abducted alongside the goddess Artemis. A joint search team of Camp Half-Blood demigods and Hunters of Artemis travels west to confront the Titan General Atlas, rescue the captives, and stop the awakening of a monstrous beast capable of destroying Olympus.
short_description: A joint quest of demigods and Hunters travels west to rescue Artemis and Annabeth from the Titan Atlas.
camp_bead_description: No bead (winter events, same year as Book 2)

title: The Battle of the Labyrinth
synopsis: Percy Jackson and his friends discover an entrance to Daedalus's subterranean Labyrinth beneath Camp Half-Blood. Fearing Luke will navigate the maze with Ariadne's String to attack the camp directly, Annabeth leads a quest deep into the subterranean labyrinth to find Daedalus and thwart Kronos's army.
short_description: Annabeth leads a perilous quest into Daedalus's subterranean maze to protect Camp Half-Blood from an invasion.

title: The Last Olympian
synopsis: As Percy Jackson turns sixteen, the Great Prophecy reaches its climax. With the major gods distracted by Typhon's rampage across the continent, Percy receives the Curse of Achilles and leads the demigods of Camp Half-Blood in a desperate, final stand across Manhattan and Mount Olympus against Kronos's invading army.
short_description: Percy Jackson leads the demigods in a final, apocalyptic defense of Manhattan against Kronos and his Titan army.
camp_bead_description: Empire State Building with names of the deceased in tiny Greek letters

title: The Demigod Files
synopsis: An insider companion collection to Camp Half-Blood featuring three secret side-quest short stories, counselor interviews, word puzzles, and maps of the camp.
short_description: A companion anthology containing three secret side quests, character interviews, and an insider guide to Camp Half-Blood.

title: Percy Jackson and the Stolen Chariot
synopsis: Percy Jackson helps Clarisse La Rue retrieve Ares's stolen war chariot from her mischievous half-brothers Phobos and Deimos in Brooklyn.
short_description: Percy and Clarisse battle Phobos and Deimos in Brooklyn to recover Ares's stolen war chariot.

title: Percy Jackson and the Bronze Dragon
synopsis: During a game of capture the flag at Camp Half-Blood, Percy, Annabeth, Charles Beckendorf, and Silena Beauregard discover a headless bronze automaton dragon in the woods and activate it to fight Myrmekes.
short_description: Demigods discover and reactivate an ancient bronze automaton dragon to rescue Charles Beckendorf from giant ants.

title: Percy Jackson and the Sword of Hades
synopsis: Persephone summons Percy, Thalia, and Nico to the Underworld to retrieve Hades's newly forged secret Stygian Iron sword before Ethan Nakamura can deliver it to Kronos.
short_description: Percy, Thalia, and Nico trek through the Underworld to retrieve Hades's stolen secret sword and confront Iapetus.

title: Percy Jackson's Greek Gods
synopsis: An illustrated lore anthology narrated in Percy Jackson's signature humorous voice, detailing the origin myths, divine domains, squabbles, and classic legends of the major Greek deities from Chaos down to the twelve Olympians.
short_description: Percy Jackson gives a humorous, first-person account of the origin stories and legends of the Greek gods.

title: Percy Jackson's Greek Heroes
synopsis: An illustrated mythology companion narrated by Percy Jackson that recounts the adventures, heroics, monsters, and tragic downfalls of ancient Greek demigods and mortals including Perseus, Theseus, Atalanta, Psyche, and Heracles.
short_description: Percy Jackson narrates the classic tales and dangerous quests of legendary ancient Greek heroes.

title: Percy Jackson and the Singer of Apollo
synopsis: On Grover's birthday in NYC, Apollo recruits Percy Jackson to help retrieve a rogue, hypnotic golden automaton singer (Celedon) who escaped before an Olympian concert.
short_description: Percy Jackson and Grover Underwood help Apollo track down a runaway automaton singer in Times Square.
